1. Acceptance of Terms
By downloading, installing, or using MedReminder (the "App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the App. If you obtained the App from Google Play, the Google Play Terms of Service also apply to you and, in the event of conflict, the Play Terms govern the Play-specific aspects of the relationship (such as payments and refunds).

2. Description of Service
MedReminder is a consumer medication reminder and self-tracking tool. It helps you track medications, set schedules, log doses, and review adherence. MedReminder is NOT a medical device under the FDA, EU MDR, UK MHRA, or equivalent regulations, has not been cleared or approved by any regulatory authority, and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, prevention, mitigation, treatment, or cure of any disease or condition.

3. Eligibility
You must be at least 18 years old, or use the App under the supervision of a parent or legal guardian. If you are using the App on behalf of another person (for example, as a caregiver), you represent that you have the authority to do so.

4. User Responsibilities
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter, including medication names, dosages, schedules, allergies, and caregiver contacts. You are solely responsible for following the instructions of your healthcare provider and the printed labelling of your medication. The App's reminders are a convenience tool only and must not be relied on as the only way to take your medications or to reach a caregiver.

5. No Medical Advice
Information shown in the App, including any AI-generated content, is for general informational and organisational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for questions about your health, medications, or treatment decisions.

6. Account and Data
MedReminder stores your data locally on your device by default. You are responsible for backing up your data. Uninstalling the App, clearing its storage, or using the "Clear all data" option in Settings will permanently delete your data on the device. You may also revoke your acceptance of these Terms at any time by uninstalling the App.

7. Subscriptions and Payments
Certain optional features may be available through a paid subscription processed by Google Play Billing. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled through your Google Play account. Refunds are handled according to the Google Play refund policy.

8. Prohibited Use
You agree not to misuse the App, reverse engineer it, attempt to extract data from other users, interfere with its normal operation, or use it in a way that violates any applicable law, including data-protection and health-information laws.

9. Disclaimer of Warranties
The App is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that reminders will always be delivered on time or that information displayed is free of error.

10. Limitation of Liability
To the fullest extent permitted by law, the developers of MedReminder are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any missed dose, adverse event, loss of data, loss of health outcome, or loss of opportunity, arising from your use of or inability to use the App. Some jurisdictions do not allow the exclusion of certain warranties or liability; in those jurisdictions, our liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted.

11. Changes to the Terms
We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, you will be asked to accept the new Terms before continuing to use the App.

12. Termination
We may suspend or terminate your access to the App at any time for any reason, including violation of these Terms. You may stop using the App at any time.

13. Governing Law
These Terms are governed by the laws of your country of residence, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules.

14. Contact
If you have questions about these Terms or require support, please contact the developer via the email address listed on the app's Google Play store listing.

1. Introduction
This Privacy Policy explains how MedReminder ("we", "us") handles information when you use the App. It is written to comply with the Google Play Developer Programme Policies (including the User Data, Health Apps, Permissions, and Families policies) as well as applicable data-protection laws such as the GDPR, UK GDPR, and the CCPA.

2. Data We Handle On-Device
MedReminder is designed to work primarily on your device. The following categories are stored locally on your device and are NOT uploaded to our servers or to Google Drive auto-backup:
- Personal info: your first name and age (as entered during onboarding).
- Health & fitness info: medication names, dosages, strengths, forms, schedules, dose logs, adherence history, and notes you add.
- Contacts: caregiver names and phone numbers you choose to enter.
- Photos or videos: images captured by the in-app camera for medication-label OCR. Images are processed on-device only and are not stored or uploaded.
- App activity and preferences: theme, language, notification and alarm settings, and the date/time you accepted this Policy.

3. Data Shared With Third-Party Services
Some optional features send data off-device. They are OFF by default and require your explicit opt-in:
- Cloud AI (optional): if you choose to enable a cloud AI provider, the medication details and questions you submit are sent to that provider (for example, an AI inference API) solely to generate the requested analysis. We do not enrich that data with other identifiers and it is not used for advertising.
- Google Play Billing: when you purchase a subscription, the transaction is processed by Google Play. We receive only the purchase state, not your payment details.
- SMS / Dialer hand-off (optional): when you use the caregiver alert feature, medication status and (if you enable emergency mode) a Google Maps link derived from your last known device location are sent as a regular SMS via your mobile carrier to the caregiver number YOU configured. The message leaves your device through your carrier, not through our servers.

4. Permissions and Why We Request Them
- Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS): to deliver medication reminders.
- Exact alarms (USE_EXACT_ALARM / SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM) and Full-screen intent: to trigger reminders at the exact time you scheduled, even while the device is idle — this is the primary purpose of the App and the reason Google Play permits these permissions.
- Boot completed & Wake lock: to reschedule reminders after a reboot and wake the screen for an alarm.
- Foreground service: to keep critical alarm handling alive.
- Camera: to scan medication labels locally. Images never leave the device.
- SMS (SEND_SMS): only used, with your opt-in, to deliver caregiver alerts to the number you configured.
- Location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION): only used, with your opt-in, to include a map link in emergency caregiver SMS. Your location is never stored in the App or transmitted to us.
- Internet / Network state: to download optional on-device AI models and, if you opt-in, reach a Cloud AI provider.
- Vibrate: reminder haptics.

5. Analytics, Advertising, and Tracking
MedReminder contains no third-party advertising SDKs, no behavioural tracking, no cross-app identifiers, and no analytics that would tie usage to your identity. We do not sell or rent personal information.

6. Cloud Backup
We explicitly exclude the medical database and app preferences from Android Auto Backup to Google Drive. Local device-to-device transfer initiated by you during a new-device setup may include this data because it does not leave your control.

7. Children
The App is not directed to children under 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. A parent or legal guardian may use the App to manage medications on a minor's behalf, in which case the adult is responsible for the data entered.

8. Data Retention and Deletion
Because your data is stored locally, you can delete all of it at any time using the "Clear all data" option in the Settings screen, or by uninstalling the App. There is no server-side account to delete. If you have contacted our support email, we retain that correspondence only for as long as is necessary to resolve your request.

9. Data Export and Portability
You can export your data as a JSON file from Settings to keep a backup or move it to another device.

10. Security
Your data is protected by the Android app sandbox and your device's encryption. However, no system is completely secure. We strongly recommend protecting your device with a screen lock and keeping Android up to date.

11. Your Rights
Depending on your jurisdiction (including the EEA/UK under GDPR, California under CCPA/CPRA, and others), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or port your personal information, and to withdraw consent. Because we do not store your data on our servers, most of these rights can be exercised from within the App itself (Settings → Clear all data, Settings → Export data). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.

12. International Transfers
If you opt in to a Cloud AI provider, the content you submit may be processed in a country different from yours. You consent to this transfer by enabling the feature.

13. Changes
We may update this Privacy Policy. If changes are material, you will be asked to accept the updated version before continuing to use the App. The "Last updated" date above reflects the current version.

14. Contact
You can reach the developer for privacy questions via the email address listed on the app's Google Play store listing. For users in the EU/UK, please use the same address to reach the data controller.

Last updated: April 2026

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

MedReminder is a consumer medication reminder and self-tracking tool. It is NOT a medical device. It has NOT been reviewed, cleared, or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the European Medicines Agency (EMA), any EU notified body under the Medical Device Regulation (MDR), the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), Health Canada, the TGA, or any other regulatory authority. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate, or prevent any disease or medical condition.

1. Not a Substitute for Professional Care
The information displayed by the App — including reminder times, dosage information you entered, adherence statistics, and any AI-generated insights — is for informational and organisational purposes only. It is not a substitute for the professional judgement of a licensed physician, pharmacist, or other qualified healthcare provider. Always follow the instructions of your healthcare provider and the printed information on your medication. If you are unsure about a dose, a symptom, or a change in your condition, contact your healthcare provider before acting.

2. No Emergency Services
The App is not intended for emergencies. If you or someone in your care is experiencing a medical emergency (including suspected overdose, severe allergic reaction, chest pain, stroke symptoms, suicidal thoughts, or any other life-threatening situation) call your local emergency number immediately. Do not rely on in-app notifications, caregiver SMS messages, or any App feature for urgent medical situations.

3. AI-Generated Content
The App may generate information using artificial intelligence (on-device or, if you opt in, cloud-based). AI output can be incomplete, outdated, or factually incorrect ("hallucinate"). Do NOT make medication, diagnosis, or treatment decisions based solely on AI output. Always verify important information with your healthcare provider, a pharmacist, or an authoritative medical source.

4. Reminder Reliability
Reminders depend on your device being powered on, with correct date and time, with notification, alarm, battery, and background permissions granted, and with sufficient battery. Battery optimisation, Doze mode, Do Not Disturb, silent modes, manufacturer-specific background restrictions, app updates, and operating-system upgrades can delay or suppress reminders. Do NOT rely on this App as the only safeguard for taking critical medications. For life-sustaining or time-critical medications, use a redundant method (for example, a pill organiser, a second alarm, or a human caregiver).

5. Dosage, Allergy and Interaction Information
You are responsible for the accuracy of medication names, strengths, forms, frequencies, and schedules you enter. The App does NOT verify prescriptions, check for drug–drug or drug–food interactions, screen for contraindications, detect allergies, or perform any clinical decision support. Consult a pharmacist or physician for those questions.

6. Caregiver Alerts (Optional)
Caregiver SMS and call-hand-off features are best-effort. Delivery depends on your cellular network, carrier, SMS-centre availability, roaming, and the caregiver's device. Do not rely on these alerts as a primary emergency response.

7. Individual Results
Every person responds to medication differently. General information in the App is not tailored to your specific condition, genetics, or medical history.

8. Acknowledgement and Indemnity
By using MedReminder, you acknowledge that you understand these limitations and that you are using the App at your own risk. You agree that the developers of MedReminder are not responsible for any health outcome, missed dose, adverse event, or other loss resulting from the use or misuse of the App. Nothing in this Disclaimer is intended to exclude liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law.
